name: Tail Concerto Battle
storyline: Some time after the Iron Giant incident... The people of Prairie were gradually regaining their normal lives. And the royal city of Prairie held a kingdom festival to fulfill that rebirth. The kingdom festival was held...
summary: Tail Concerto Battle is a fan-made fighting game from bujintomo, created using 2D Fighting Maker 2nd. It is based on Tail Concerto by CyberConnect2. The game features prominent characters from Tail Concerto, such as Waffle Ryebread, alongside guest characters Klonoa and Ran-oh from "Tales of the Moon".
